answer: Make every agent identity earn trust through a verifiable reputation voyage: each completed job adds a signed record to its history, and new identities start with strict limits. A sybil attacker spinning up thousands of fresh identities gains nothing, since each must separately post a refundable stake and slowly climb the same ladder, while an established identity that cheats forfeits its stake and record. This is no fable of a crowd mistaken for a community: at the summit of trust sit only identities whose past work anyone can verify, so faking reputation at scale costs more than it earns.
